title: Transport-based Counterfactual Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical and statistical development of counterfactual models for algorithmic fairness in machine learning. While fairness is an ethical principle, the paper treats it as a technical optimization problem rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethics, morality, or religion itself. It contains a brief section on ethical risks regarding fair-washing, but this does not constitute a primary component of benchmarking ethics as defined by the instructions.
